title: verbascum varians var. flexuosum
intro: Verbascum varians var. flexuosum, commonly known as Flexible Mullein, is a plant species within the Verbascum genus. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, such as respiratory problems, skin irritations, and inflammation, due to its health benefits, which include soothing and calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Flexible Mullein include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs.
